name: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd.
about: Syrma SGS Technology Limited operates as an electronics system design and manufacturing company in India, the United States, Germany, and internationally. The company offers electronic manufacturing services, such as PCBAs for industries and end applications; assemblies, including PCBAs, enclosures, wire harnesses, testing, and custom packing; EOL and functional testers based on customer specifications; cables with cutting, stripping, tinning, crimping, over molding, and ultrasonic welding; and injection molding. It also provides engineering and technology services comprising product engineering, digital engineering, design studio, and prototyping; and medtech ODM services consisting of homogenization, electrotherapy, colorimetry, laser therapy, RF therapy, and spectrophotometry. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~34% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 69 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 86), though that is a short history to judge by.
PE 69 is 49% above the sector median, but its ROCE and growth largely justify that premium.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 44% a year while PE moved 62 → 69.
